data.exact_reserve_text: The profit on the technical account of GBP 68.7m (2013: profit GBP 79.7m) includes a run-off surplus of GBP 5.2m for prior accident years (2013: GBP 10.1m surplus). This included a surplus of GBP 13.4m for reinsurance acceptance business and a deficit of GBP 8.2m on direct business (2013: surplus of GBP 7.2m for reinsurance acceptance business and a surplus of GBP 2.9m on direct business).
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1414 reported an overall run-off surplus on prior accident years of GBP 5.2m for 2014, reflecting a GBP 13.4m surplus on reinsurance acceptance business offset by an GBP 8.2m deficit on direct business, resulting in a net prior-year release. Management noted there were no major catastrophe losses in 2014 or 2013, although there were a number of significant attritional losses.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure sourced from Note 7 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which reports a run-off surplus of GBP 5.2m (interpreted as a gross figure). The note does not present a three-column movement table explicitly labelled 'Insurance liabilities' vs 'Reinsurer's share', so gross/net ambiguity exists; confidence reduced accordingly. No gross claims development triangle was found in the report to cross-check the PYD calculation. 'Direct business' was mapped to 'Aggregate' for LOB movements since the report splits only between direct and reinsurance acceptance business.
